target: forge.sh push — gitlab over https authenticates via GIT_CONFIG_* scoped to the remote URL, never argv or disk
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
TOK=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
export FORGE_TOKEN=$TOK
fx_run push claude/idea-x; fx_show r
cat "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/git-push.log" 2>/dev/null
fx_reqs_clear
fx_setremote https://gitlab.example.test:8443/grp/proj.git
fx_run push claude/idea-x; fx_show port
echo "port_keys=$(tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/git-push.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'keys=[^ ]*' | sed 's/^keys=//')"
fx_calls_text
fx_tokscan "$TOK"
fx_done
